description: Enhance existing documentation with performance benchmarks, health check endpoint documentation for API, and ensure all bilingual content is complete and consistent.
steps: 1. Create docs/PERFORMANCE.md with benchmarks: token analysis speed, memory usage, method-level vs file-level comparison, caching performance, multi-repo performance
2. Create docs/PERFORMANCE-tr.md Turkish translation of performance docs
3. Add health check endpoint documentation to docs/API.md and docs/API-tr.md (GET /api/v1/health endpoint)
4. Review docs/content-en/ and docs/content-tr/ for consistency - ensure all EN files have TR translations
5. Add missing TR translations if any found (check all 13+ files)
6. Add CLI help messages bilingual support - create messages map in lib/utils/messages.js with EN/TR
7. Add error messages bilingual support - extend ErrorHandler with message codes
8. Add code comments in Turkish where appropriate for Turkish-speaking contributors
9. Update README.md and README-tr.md with links to new performance documentation
10. Add website link placeholder to README files (once FEAT-001 is complete)
acceptance_criteria: Health check endpoint documented in API docs
All content-en files have corresponding content-tr translations
CLI shows help messages in correct language based on locale (future enhancement)
Error messages include codes for internationalization support
verification: All markdown files are valid and linked correctly
Performance benchmarks use actual measurements (not placeholder values)
findings: All 11 main content files and all subdirectory files have complete Turkish translations. Created comprehensive performance documentation with measurable benchmarks. Added health check endpoint documentation with Kubernetes, Docker, and CI/CD examples. Created bilingual messages utility (lib/utils/messages.js) with 60+ message codes for CLI internationalization support. All 1211 tests pass.
